subject: resident custody landed: orphan-safe TUI surface and idle-exit encounter owner
result: Fixed the two process-custody defects behind the Sep 25 rogue-process incident (working tree, uncommitted, on latest origin/main ce0e528b). (1) aikit-tui surface loop now draws only when a frame-changing event arrives (idle ticks and mouse motion triggered full redraws at 10fps forever) and closes when the process is orphaned (parent-change watchdog), so a palette whose terminal died can no longer spin for days - the incident process burned ~74% CPU for 4.6 days. Proven by crates/aikit-tui/tests/surface_loop_custody_v2.rs (3 tests, counting backend). (2) encounter-serve now has explicit resident custody: --idle-exit-secs (default 21600, 0 disables) exits an owner no client has talked to, and SIGTERM/SIGINT are forwarded through signal-hook into the same graceful path as an explicit Shutdown request, so resident agents (pi children) are reaped and journalled instead of orphaned - the incident TERM left three pi agents alive for days. Proven by an_idle_owner_exits_and_leaves_no_socket_behind (lib test), the existing encounter_shutdown integration suite, and live binary replays: SIGTERM gives exit 0 with socket removed; --idle-exit-secs 1 self-exits with socket removed. Docs: resident-custody paragraph added to docs/encounter-runtime.md. Verification: scripts/verify quick -p aikit-tui -p aikit-cli = 1194/1195; the one failure (knowledge_project_code_scope_real) proven pre-existing by stash-replay (installed gitnexus CLI rejects the query; same degradation aikit knowledge search showed this session); clippy -D warnings clean; git diff --check clean. Proposal, not implemented (spans O-I ground): gateway serve has the same no-custody shape; the standing launchd gateway must keep running (it hosts the routine dispatcher), so the proportionate fix is an opt-in --idle-exit-secs on gateway serve plus adoption by O-I campaign spawners; stray campaign gateways are meanwhile covered by the machine process-hygiene sweep. Note: the incident ran the INSTALLED ~/.local/bin/aikit, which still carries the spin bug until this lands and is reinstalled.
